Decision.AttributionNote: The Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Dawei Wufeng Xue (大溈五峰學禪師語錄), in Tao Runai's pagoda inscription for Wufeng Ruxue. Wufeng Ruxue is the exact grammatical actor who inherits the Dharma from Tiantong Miyun Yuanwu (五峰禪師，嗣法於天童密雲悟和尚). The short title candidate ‘Wufeng’ names a different Tang master in the current roster and must not be substituted for the source's late-Ming Wufeng Ruxue.
